findings.event: Company discloses first concrete Hypercon clinical timeline (H1 2027 first dosing; 2030-2031 potential launches) at Wells Fargo Healthcare Conference
findings.summary: Halozyme CEO Helen Torley and CFO Darren Snellgrove said the company's first two Hypercon-based clinical programs are expected to begin dosing in H1 2027, with potential first commercial launches in 2030-2031; company now describes four SC delivery platforms (ENHANZE, an auto-injector platform, Hypercon, Surf Bio).
